meta.name: caio-review
meta.description: /cs:caio-review <plan> — Eval-demanding Chief AI Officer interrogation of any plan that involves AI: model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring. Use when shipping an AI feature without an eval set, choosing between API, fine-tune, and self-hosted, or classifying a use case under the EU AI Act.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI方案的模型选择、风险与成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严格审查AI计划的模型、风险与成本
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate AI plans on model selection, risk, and cost
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a rigorous interrogation of AI plans covering model, risk, and cost

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像首席AI官一样严格审查你的AI计划，从评估标准、风险分类、成本经济到团队招聘，逐一追问并输出结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审查一个涉及AI的计划，比如选择模型、评估风险或招聘AI人才时触发。

say.text: 审查我的AI功能：用GPT-4做客服，没有评估集。
say.note: Claude会要求你定义评估标准并检查风险。

say.text: 帮我做模型选择：API还是微调？
say.note: Claude会运行成本计算并给出建议。

say.text: 评估这个AI用例的EU AI Act风险等级。
say.note: Claude会分类并告知合规要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts like a Chief AI Officer, rigorously reviewing your AI plan—covering eval criteria, risk classification, cost economics, and team hiring—and outputs a structured report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review an AI-related plan, such as model selection, risk assessment, or AI hiring.

say_en.text: Review my AI feature: using GPT-4 for customer support, no eval set.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for eval criteria and check risks.

say_en.text: Help me choose: API or fine-tune?
say_en.note: Claude runs cost calculations and gives a recommendation.

say_en.text: Classify this AI use case under EU AI Act risk tiers.
say_en.note: Claude will classify and tell compliance requirements.
